name: B1 unknown-reference process robustness v1
question: Does the frozen guarded process improve on native CPOP when every method receives the same predicted reference? Can one pre-notice level adjustment improve the practical chain?
selection: Fixed user split 50/20/15/15 using seed+5; eligible held-out contexts have lead15; ascending event ID, at most one per user, first2. No selection on power, response, latent baseline or error. Retain shortfalls and use equal seed weights; stop without replacing a seed if a block has zero contexts.
training: Current formal fit_reference, unchanged hyperparameters. Only training users' completed historical days j>=2; prior for day j uses strictly earlier days0..j-1. Historical day j starts100000+1440*j, fit cutoff120000. Query starts300000+1440*context_index; all model inputs and prior sources available before notice. Explicit synthetic availability declarations, not real source provenance.
stress_definition: Reuse frozen shape/truth_average evaluator. Interval reduction=min(desired interval reduction, true interval baseline), so noiseless power is nonnegative. Paired independent Gaussian meter noise across methods/references/shapes within each context. Evaluation targets are one-minute interval quantities; no latent physical timing claim.
candidate: One fixed candidate: mean(observed power - GBDT reference) on complete[-30,-15] relative minutes, strictly at/before notice; add same shift to reference then floor at0. No offset tuning, no post-notice input. Window residual calibration is not pointwise sigma.
fairness: Same reference, same meter observations, same declared sigma, task and evaluation target for all methods. Oracle is a separate diagnostic branch that intentionally supplies true baseline to every method; practical branches never receive it. RIDE uses the existing frozen3-start no-CI/BIC candidate adapter, not its entire default pipeline.
metrics: no-action onset false-positive fraction under common F0 observed-threshold rule
onset/recovery conditional MAE with jointly available denominator and missed/extra detections
raw eta error shared across process methods
development_admission: For BOTH native CPOP and guarded: all4 paired seed mean curve RMSE differences <=0; aggregate relative improvement >=5%; no-action false-positive fraction increase <=0.05. This is a finite heuristic, not a population error-rate guarantee.
test_adoption: Candidate can enter source as opt-in only if development admitted and BOTH CPOP and guarded paired20-seed mean curve-error difference MC95 upper<0 and no-action false-positive fraction increase<=0.05. Preserve existing default and all negative findings. No retuning on this test.
inference: Seed blocks are independent units; contexts, shapes, references and methods are paired variants. Student-t MC95 for mean paired seed differences, not exact population coverage. At most40 no-action contexts in test; cannot establish a5% false-positive guarantee.
stop: One candidate, one development admission, one fresh test. No expanding resources, networks, thresholds or sample to force gain. No reports, no changes to old experiments. Causal AIPW performance is a separate subsequent question; eta error alone does not prove incentive contrast bias.
